content: महत् {%a.%} [मह्-अति] (<ab>compar.</ab> महीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> महिष्ठ; <ab>nom.</ab> महान्, महान्तौ, महान्तः; <ab>acc.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab> महतः) .²1 Great, big, large, huge, vast; महान् सिंहः, व्याघ्रः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Ample, copious, abundant, many, numerous; महाजनः, महान् द्रव्यराशिः. .²3 Long, extended, extensive; महान्तौ बाहू यस्य स महाबाहुः; so महती कथा, महानध्वा. .²4 Strong, powerful, mighty; as महान् वीरः. .²5 Violent, intense, excessive; महती शिरोवेदना, महती पिपासा. .²6 Gross, thick, dense; महानन्धकारः. .²7 Important, weighty, momentous; महत्कार्यमुपस्थितम्, महती वार्ता. .²8 High, lofty, eminent, distinguished, noble; महत्कुलम्, महाञ् जनः. .²9 Loud; महान् घोषः--ध्वनिः. .²10 Early or late; महति प्रत्यूषे ‘early in the morning’; महत्यपराह्णे ‘late in the afternoon’. .²11 High; महार्घ. --{%m.%} .²1 A camel. .²2 An epithet of Śiva. .²3 (In <ab>Sāṅ. phil.</ab>) The great principle, the intellect (distinguished from मनस्), the second of the twenty-five elements or {%tattvas%} recognized by the Sāṅkhyas; <ls>Ms. 1. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 14</ls>; महदाद्याः प्रकृतिविकृतयः सप्त <ls>Sāṅ. K. 3</ls>, <ls n="Sāṅ. K.">8</ls>, <ls n="Sāṅ. K.">22</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 The superior of a monastery. --{%n.%} .²1 Greatness, infiniteness, numerousness. .²2 Kingdom, dominion; ‘महद्राज्यविशालयोः’ <ls>Viśva.</ls>; इन्द्रियाणि महत्प्रेप्सुः <ls>Mb. 5. 129. 26</ls>. .²3 Sacred knoweldge. .²4 The Supreme Being (परमात्मा); बुद्धेः परतरं ज्ञानं ज्ञानात् परतरं महत् <ls>Mb. 12. 204. 10</ls>. --{%ind.%} Greatly, excessively, very much, exceedingly; त्रैलोक्योद्वेगदं महत् <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 48</ls>. ({%Note%}: महत् as the first member of a Tatpuruṣa compound and a few other cases, remains unchanged, while in Karmadhāraya and Bahuvrīhi <ab>comp.</ab> it is changed to महा <ab>q. v.</ab>)
